Name: Katia Managan farm cat retexture
Author: AMKitsune
Description:
When asked to choose a name for my farm cat, I went for the first name that came to mind. Katia Managan.

Unfortunately, the cat that I received looks nothing like her.
A quick trip into Photoshop and a few minutes later we have what I believe might be the first Prequel mod for Stardew Valley. Yay me?

Anyway, I can think of a number of people who'll likely want to name their cats as I have. Now they can re-skin their cat too! (that sounds more painful that it should do...)
